resources.note: The Pa-Auk method in its own setting: a 123-day jhāna retreat. Pa-Auk Sayadaw gives the opening instructions and the closing questions and answers; Sayadaw U Jagara, who assisted him for a decade, gives 35 talks: the gradual training, purpose and balance in practice, the planes of existence, the elements, defining mind and matter and their causes, the 24 conditions of the Paṭṭhāna, and emptiness.
